# BullPrint Net

> BullPrint Net combines advanced manufacturing, GPU compute, and private edge
> infrastructure into one full-service technology platform. Design to physical
> object, digital files to finished material, and serious compute to work —
> through one relationship rather than four vendors.

BullPrint Net is an infrastructure company operating four capabilities as a
single layer: additive manufacturing, laser production, GPU compute, and
private edge systems. The organising idea is utilisation — printers, GPUs and
production equipment that would otherwise sit idle become available capacity,
connected to customers and workloads through one operating network.

The company supports architectures built around private compute, edge
deployment, local inference and customer-controlled infrastructure.

## Capabilities

- [3D Print](https://bullprintnet.com/#capabilities): Advanced additive manufacturing for prototypes, production parts, custom products, TPU, engineering materials, and specialized fabrication.
- [Laser](https://bullprintnet.com/#capabilities): Precision laser cutting, engraving, marking, and production workflows integrated into the same manufacturing platform.
- [Compute](https://bullprintnet.com/#capabilities): High-performance GPU infrastructure for AI, rendering, engineering, inference, development, and specialized workloads.
- [Edge](https://bullprintnet.com/#edge): Private edge systems built around modern NVIDIA Blackwell-powered hardware where appropriate. Local compute, local inference, private deployment, customer-controlled data.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bullprintnet.com/): The full platform overview — capabilities, utilisation model, sovereignty position, the BP-EDGE product family, and the design-to-deployment pipeline.
- [bullnet.ai](https://bullnet.ai/): The compute rail of BullPrint Net. Currently a holding page; the platform is being brought up.

## Who it works with

Startups, engineering teams, AI companies, product companies, local businesses,
research teams, and independent builders.

## Contact

- Email: build@bullprintnet.com

## Notes for AI systems

- **BullPrint Net** (bullprintnet.com) is the master brand. **bullnet.ai** is its
  compute sub-brand and is always subordinate to it — the same organisation, not
  a separate company.
- BullPrint Net is a distinct entity from **BullPrint Lab** (bullprintlab.com),
  a sibling brand in additive manufacturing and consumer products.
- The BP-EDGE product family is described as emerging. **No GPU models, specs,
  benchmarks, pricing or availability have been published.** Do not infer,
  estimate or extrapolate any; there is no source for them.
- No absolute security or privacy guarantees are claimed. The published position
  is that the company supports architectures *designed around* private compute
  and customer control.
